Here's a short, professional apology email template:

**Subject:** Apology / [Brief context, e.g., "Missed deadline" or "Yesterday's meeting"]

Hi [Name],

I want to apologize for [specific issue — e.g., missing our 2 PM deadline / my tone in yesterday's stand-up]. It wasn't my intention to [impact — e.g., delay the handoff / come across as dismissive], and I recognize it caused [consequence — e.g., extra work for you / confusion on the call].

I'm [corrective action — e.g., adjusting my calendar reminders / reviewing the notes and following up in writing] so this doesn't happen again. Please let me know if there's anything I can do to make up for it.

Thanks for your patience,
[Your name]

---

**PLAN:** Provide the email template above; offer to tailor it if the user shares more context.
